rules: Treat original talking-head and rendered-human footage as replaceable footage plates unless separate layers are visually evidenced.
Do not invent exact font families; preserve typography class, width, weight, placement, color and timing.
Do not call apparent crop/subject-scale variation a physical camera move without additional evidence.
Enable motion blur only for fast transform/transition events; original shutter angle is unknown.
Instagram UI is SOURCE_LOCK in exact reconstruction and must be stripped from reusable templates.
